title: RTLREX: LLM-Guided Framework for Exact High-Level RTL Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.10798v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hardware designs may be available only as gate-level netlists or input-output descriptions when the original register-transfer-level (RTL) design and documentation are not accessible. Low-level representations obscure word-level computation and its finite-width behavior. Recovering high-level RTL from such representations therefore helps engineers understand a circuit's functionality and enables RTL rewriting and resynthesis. A plausible function candidate is also insufficient unless the generated RTL is equivalent to the original circuit for all input combinations. In this paper, we present RTLREX, a large language model (LLM)-guided framework that coordinates domain-specific tools for function recovery, RTL generation, independent verification, and cost-guided rewriting. translated_title: RTLREX：基于大语言模型引导的精确高层次RTL恢复框架
translated_abstract: 当原始的寄存器传输级（RTL）设计和文档不可获取时，硬件设计可能仅以门级网表或输入-输出描述的形式存在。低层次表示会掩盖字级计算及其有限位宽行为。因此，从这些表示中恢复高层次RTL有助于工程师理解电路的功能，并支持RTL重写与重新综合。仅有一个看似合理的功能候选是不够的，除非生成的RTL在所有输入组合下都与原始电路等价。本文提出了RTLREX，这是一个由大语言模型（LLM）引导的框架，它协调领域专用工具来完成功能恢复、RTL生成、独立验证和成本引导的重写。独立验证用于确立恢复的RTL与原始电路之间的等价性。LLM利用工具反馈来选择进一步的分析……
tldr: RTLREX是一个由大语言模型引导的框架，通过协调功能恢复、RTL生成、独立验证和成本引导重写等专用工具，从门级网表或输入-输出描述中精确恢复与原始电路在所有输入组合下完全等价的高层次RTL。
en_tdlr: RTLREX is an LLM-guided framework that coordinates domain-specific tools for function recovery, RTL generation, independent verification, and cost-guided rewriting to recover high-level RTL exactly equivalent to the original circuit for all input combinations from gate-level netlists or input-output descriptions.
